title: Does the Model Use What It Cites? Counterfactual Tests of Grounded Reasoning Chains in Small Video-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21940v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A grounded reasoning chain cites a frame span and a box for every step, so a reader can check where the model looked. Whether the answer depends on the cited region is a different question. We test it by intervention: the regions a model cited in its own chain are blacked out, and the share of correct answers that flip is compared with blacking out boxes of the same size elsewhere on the same frames. The paired difference, the cite gap, needs no annotation. We apply it to 2-3B video-language models trained on exact CLEVRER chains and on pseudo-labelled NExT-QA chains. With the same weights, the cite gap is 0.089 on CLEVRER and 0.003 on NExT-QA. Pooled over models, masking the cited boxes flips 2.2 times as many correct answers as the control on CLEVRER and 1.1 times as many on NExT-QA, also among the answers that depend on the video at all, while the boxes pass a grounding check on both. translated_title: 模型是否真的使用了它所引用的内容？小型视频语言模型中接地推理链的反事实检验
translated_abstract: 接地推理链在每一步都引用一个帧区间和一个边界框，使读者能够检查模型观察的位置。然而，答案是否真正依赖于所引用的区域则是另一个问题。我们通过干预实验来检验这一点：将模型在其自身推理链中引用的区域涂黑，并将正确答案翻转的比例与在同一帧其他位置涂黑相同大小框的结果进行对比。这种成对差异被称为“引用差距”，且无需任何标注。我们将其应用于在精确CLEVRER推理链和伪标注NExT-QA推理链上训练的2-3B参数视频语言模型。在相同的模型权重下，引用差距在CLEVRER上为0.089，而在NExT-QA上仅为0.003。汇总所有模型的结果，遮蔽所引用的框在CLEVRER上导致翻转的正确答案数量是对照组的2.2倍，在NExT-QA上为1.1倍——即使仅考虑那些确实依赖视频的答案也是如此，同时这些引用框在两个数据集上均通过了接地性检查。而当在每一帧上遮蔽所引用的实体时
tldr: 本文提出一种无需标注的“引用差距”反事实检验方法，通过涂黑模型推理链中所引用的视频区域来验证小型视频语言模型是否真正依赖其引用的证据，结果显示模型在CLEVRER上具有较强证据依赖性，但在NExT-QA上依赖性很弱。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an annotation-free "cite gap" counterfactual test that blacks out regions cited in a model's reasoning chain to verify whether small video-language models genuinely rely on the evidence they cite, finding strong evidence-dependence on CLEVRER but weak dependence on NExT-QA.
